notes:
CRM notes / call snippets: 
- Account: NexClip — SaaS CRM/KB product that surfaces customer docs and articles inside customers' apps. High QPS business: peak 800-1,200 qps expected across NA users; typical 24/7 traffic.
- Primary ask: hosted API solution to replace partial stack (current: keywords + Pinecone for vectors). Goal is to consolidate retrieval + cross-encoder rerank into one predictable runtime to lower 95p latency and cost-per-query.
- Indexing scale: target ~1.8M doc chunks (avg 300-600 tokens), ~2.1M vectors after chunking. Embedding dim target 1536. Update cadence: daily incremental ingest ~50k docs.
- Latency SLO: retrieval (ANN + kNN) <100ms p50, reranker (cross-encoder) <120ms p50, end-to-end target <350ms p95 for typical queries.
- Throughput: 1,200 qps sustained target for peak windows; spikes up to 2,500 qps for marketing events. Need autoscaling and graceful fallback (smaller reranker or candidate-only scoring).
- Cost sensitivity: engineering wants cost per end-user query (embeddings + retrieval + rerank) < $0.03, ideally ~ $0.015. Budget modeled to ARR 50-150k for hosted API commit; open to Dedicated if costs scale better.
- Model preferences: prefer open/quantized embedding model (instruction embeddings) and small cross-encoder reranker (cost-effective). Want Redwood recommendations on batching, cache TTLs, and quantization profiles via Optimize.
- Security/compliance: must have SOC2, SSO/SAML integration (Okta), audit logs retained 90+ days, KMS integration for key separation. Data residency: US (us-east) required for some customers.
- Ops needs: per-route latency/cost dashboards, token-level billing by route, canary rollout for reranker models. They emphasized deterministic rollback for model regressions.
- POC plan (4 weeks): Week 1: ingest 200k canonical KB docs + setup embeddings pipeline. Week 2: vector indexing & ANN config, tune recall at k. Week 3: integrate cross-encoder reranker (A/B) + small model fallback. Week 4: load testing 500-1,200 qps, measure cost/query & latency SLOs; deliver report and recommended config.
- Quotes: "If we can get stable 300ms p95 with rerank and keep costs below ~0.02, we'll convert" — Head of Search Product.
- Internal AE notes: Diego to lead POC, require SE time for reranker tuning and load test (2-3 days week 3). Ask legal to start MSA review early.
- Integration notes: current infra uses Okta SSO, Postgres for metadata, and Edge caching in front of vectors. They want Redwood-hosted embeddings but ability to export vectors to their Pinecone for DR.
- Linked artifacts: pricing deck + security spreadsheet shared in Drive. Jira RDINF-4129 opened for SOC2 doc request. Gmail thread created for contract negotiation.
